create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with pad, eos, unk, bos, and mask special symbols
load_dictionary_from_file: load a Dictionary from a text file using Dictionary.load with symbol and count pairs
encode_line_to_ids: encode a text line into token indices using Dictionary.encode_line with optional eos append
finalize_dictionary: finalize a Dictionary by sorting symbols by frequency with threshold and nwords limits
convert_tensor_to_string: convert a tensor of token indices back to a string using Dictionary.string with BPE support
